reason: Classified as a file/terminal utility plugin because it is centered on user-controlled write access boundaries for agent actions, not content creation or external integrations. Evidence from the README and manifest shows it adds a new permission mode and UI to choose writable directories, then enforces those choices in filesystem and shell sandboxes.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中新增“选定工作区写入”权限选项，通过目录树选择器限制代理可写目录，用于控制工作区文件写入范围。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Selected Workspace Write permission mode in DeepSeek Harness sessions, allowing users to choose writable directories in a tree selector to control where the agent can write files and use terminal writes.

capabilities: Directory-tree selection for writable workspace paths
Enforcement for filesystem tools and shell/terminal write access
Escalation prompt for writes outside selected scope

reasons.code: README describes a new `selected-workspace-write` permission mode that lets users check directories in a tree editor to define writable scope.
README states enforcement applies in both filesystem tools and shell/terminal sandboxes, limiting writes to selected directories plus platform temp areas.
README notes the permission selection is stored in the session log and restored on resume.
package.json declares this as a DSH plugin with a web client inject and bundle patch, confirming integration into the platform UI and runtime.
